headline: Not another podcast. An institution for conversation.
body: MNIT Jaipur has clubs for debate, media, photography and filmmaking. What it did not have was a dedicated, institute-wide platform that trains students in the craft of research, interviewing, moderation and long-form conversation, and builds a permanent archive of the people and ideas shaping this institution.
The Institute of Conversations is a student-run institution with its own leadership structure, recruitment cycle, training and succession pipeline. Podcasting is simply its flagship medium.
quote: We do not seek to create another podcast at MNIT Jaipur. We seek to build an institutional ecosystem for conversations, interviewing, research and storytelling, with podcasting as its flagship medium.
